title: EV ShareGrid AI Engine measured benchmark

assumptions.station_hours: Active stations in source catalog are marked 24h.
assumptions.connector_mismatch: Requests retain the vehicle model connector; mismatches remain unmet and are counted in KPI.
assumptions.cluster_execution: Separate POST /ai/benchmark calls per cluster; aggregate cost, shortfall, solve_ms and violations by sum, on-time rate by request count, and peak from combined per-slot schedules.
